title: PATCH /api/projects/:id/todos/:tid — update to-do (complete/uncomplete/edit)
description: Update a todo's title, completion state, urgency, or due date. Completing awards +10 points; uncompleting deducts -10 points. Progress is recalculated after any change.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH requires auth and project ownership
Accepts partial: { title?, isCompleted?, isUrgent?, dueDate?, milestoneId? }
Completing a todo (isCompleted: true) awards +10 points
Unchecking a todo (isCompleted: false) deducts -10 points
completed_at is set on completion, cleared on uncheck
Returns 200 with updated todo and current progress

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find todo WHERE id = tid AND project_id = id (return 404 if not found). 3) Validate body. 4) Detect completion state change. 5) Update todo fields. If completing: set completed_at = NOW(), call awardPoints(projectId, 10, 'Completed todo: TITLE', 'todo'). If unchecking: set completed_at = null, call awardPoints(projectId, -10, 'Unchecked todo: TITLE', 'todo'). 6) Call recalculateProgress(projectId). 7) Return 200 { todo: updatedTodo, progress: newProgress }.
Complete a todo — verify +10 points, progress updated, completed_at set. Uncheck it — verify -10 points, progress updated, completed_at cleared. Update only title — no points change.
